name: 01-depth
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design an original refined professional logo for Searix Trade, a mobile Solana trading app about clarity before signing. Flat vector-style brand artwork, sharp clean edges, minimal geometry, strong silhouette recognizable at small app-icon sizes. Primary color #6D5DF6 violet, wordmark #15161F, optional secondary #8B7CF7. Text exactly 'Searix Trade', elegant Plus Jakarta Sans-inspired rounded geometric sans serif, Searix bold and Trade regular. Center a generous icon above the wordmark, balanced compact lockup with generous clear space. Transparent background. No mockup, no photography, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no extra text, no existing crypto brand symbols. Create the DEPTH concept: an original S monogram constructed from three offset solid horizontal order-book slabs with subtly curved terminals, clever negative-space diagonal breaks. Sculptural but strictly flat. Avoid generic bar charts, arrows and dollar signs.
